description: Corporate actions for one symbol across all years: dividends, splits, bonuses and rights, with ex dates, ratios and amounts, newest first. Required: symbol. Up to 100 rows per call. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. No API key needed.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Exchange ticker, for example RELIANCE, TCS, M&M. Case does not matter.
